_comment: Caelestia's design system, extracted from the LIVE Config.appearance singleton
This is the source of truth for making KDE Plasma wear Caelestia's design.
It is DESIGN ONLY - geometry, type and motion. Colours are NOT here on purpose:
they change with the wallpaper and live in ~/.local/state/caelestia/scheme.json,
which luminos-kde-caelestia-theme reads directly at apply time.
How this was obtained (repeat it if caelestia-shell is upgraded):
the values are NOT greppable on disk - Caelestia 2.2.0 embeds its QML in a Qt
resource inside libcaelestia-configplugin.so. Run a throwaway quickshell config
that imports Caelestia.Config and walks Config.appearance. See the header of

spacing._comment: identical scale to rounding - Material 3 4pt grid

font._unit: size in logical px, weight in CSS units

border._comment: the gap Caelestia reserves around the screen, and its corner radius

layout._comment: Caelestia's bar is a VERTICAL strip on the LEFT edge, not a top/bottom bar.
layout.reserved: [l60, t10, r10, b10] on eDP-2 (1440x900 logical)

_comment: px -> pt conversion for KDE font settings: pt = round(px * 72 / 96) = round(px * 0.75).
KDE stores fonts in POINTS; Caelestia's tokens are logical PIXELS. Do not paste px
straight into kdeglobals or every label will be ~33% too big.
